meta.name: Man on Fire
meta.description: Haunted by his past and hunted by his enemies, a Special Forces veteran fights to keep a teenage girl alive on the deadly streets of Rio de Janeiro.

videos.title: One
videos.overview: Sidelined by PTSD, Special Forces veteran John Creasy gets a second chance when an old friend hires him to investigate a terrorist plot in Brazil.

videos.title: Two
videos.overview: As they face relentless attacks from all sides, Creasy tries to help Poe reclaim her memories — and discovers no one can really be trusted.

videos.title: Three
videos.overview: Creasy leverages Tiago to gain access to Osmar's hideout. Poe befriends a sensitive teen enlisted to protect her from the dangers of the favela.

videos.title: Four
videos.overview: The favela goes on high alert when enemies arrive with an agenda. Creasy races against time to extract information in a high-stakes hostage situation.

videos.title: Five
videos.overview: With a new adversary on his trail, Creasy hatches a plan to get Poe and the others out of the country. Vico offers Livro a chance at a fresh start.

videos.title: Six
videos.overview: Creasy stages a daring prison heist to secure an important target. Melo takes the wheel for a dangerous rescue mission.

videos.title: Seven
videos.overview: Cornered and exposed, Creasy sets a trap to lure his enemies into the flames — even if it means he burns alongside them.
